resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources spell the name Yocum (firetower.org, firelookout.com) or Yokum (willhiteweb.com, the Washington index); the story uses Yocum, the spelling in the FFLOS record title.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1935 build and the 1940s abandonment, but none gives an exact abandonment year or a removal date, and no staffing or fire history was found. Only willhiteweb.com describes the site on the ground (no evidence of the lookout), and its visit date is not stated. The FFLOS page shows a registration date of April 20, 2020, which is recorded as an event. Willhite's note that the lookout is on a 1957 map but not a 1941 map is left unexplained; it does not conflict with a 1935 build but may reflect a map omission. Access is recorded as public because the land is Colville National Forest; no source gives a closure or permit rule.
